title: Molecular mechanism of Gancao Xiexin Decoction regulating EMT and suppressing hepatic metastasis of gastric cancer via the TGF-beta1/SMAD pathway.
authors: Liu, Wenjing; Lu, Doudou; Jia, Shumin; Yang, Yating; Meng, Fandi; Du, Yuhua; Yang, Yi; Yuan, Ling; Nan, Yi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过TGF-beta1/SMAD通路抑制胃癌肝转移，虽含分子对接但核心为网络药理学与湿实验验证，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Gastric cancer (GC) is a highly malignant tumor of the digestive tract, posing a significant menace to human health. Gancao Xiexin Decoction (GCXXD), being a traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), has a good effect on inhibiting the proliferation and metastasis of GC. However, its mechanisms still need further investigation. AIM OF STUDY: To investigate the mechanism by which GCXXD inhibits GC metastasis through network pharmacology, and to verify through in vivo and in vitro experiments. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The TCMSP and GEO databases, in combination with UPLC-MS/MS techniques, were employed to identify the hub genes, active ingredients, and critical pathways of GCXXD in the treatment of GC. Subsequently, molecular docking was conducted on both the hub genes and the core components. Finally, based on the results of the bioinformatics analysis, the role of GCXXD in inhibiting liver metastasis of GC was elucidated through in vivo and in vitro experiments, including scratch assays, Transwell assays, HE staining, immunohistochemistry, in vivo live imaging, qRT-PCR, and Western blotting. RESULTS: Utilizing UPLC-MS/MS and network pharmacology, we identified 20 active ingredients and 5 hub targets in the treatment of GC by GCXXD. Through KEGG analyses, GCXXD treatment of GC could through the TGF-beta pathway. In vivo and in vitro experiments, GCXXD downregulated the mRNA and protein expression level of hub genes involved in the TGF-beta1/SMAD pathway and the EMT process. Additionally, GCXXD significantly reduced the incidence of liver metastases in GC. CONCLUSION: GCXXD inhibited EMT via blocking the TGF-beta1/SMAD pathway, which suppressed GC cell growth and liver metastasis. This study provides data to support the treatment of liver metastasis in GC with TCM and holds significant importance for the research and development of new anticancer drugs.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：胃癌（Gastric cancer, GC）是一种高度恶性的消化道肿瘤，对人类健康构成重大威胁。甘草泻心汤（Gancao Xiexin Decoction, GCXXD）作为一种中药（traditional Chinese medicine, TCM），在抑制胃癌增殖和转移方面具有良好的效果。然而，其机制仍需进一步研究。研究目的：通过网络药理学研究GCXXD抑制胃癌转移的机制，并通过体内和体外实验进行验证。材料与方法：采用TCMSP和GEO数据库，结合UPLC-MS/MS技术，鉴定GCXXD治疗胃癌的核心基因、活性成分和关键通路。随后，对核心基因和核心成分进行分子对接。最后，基于生物信息学分析结果，通过划痕实验、Transwell实验、HE染色、免疫组化、体内活体成像、qRT-PCR和Western blotting等体内和体外实验，阐明GCXXD抑制胃癌肝转移的作用。结果：利用UPLC-MS/MS和网络药理学，我们鉴定了GCXXD治疗胃癌的20种活性成分和5个核心靶点。通过KEGG分析，GCXXD治疗胃癌可能通过TGF-beta通路发挥作用。在体内和体外实验中，GCXXD下调了TGF-beta1/SMAD通路和EMT过程中核心基因的mRNA和蛋白表达水平。此外，GCXXD显著降低了胃癌肝转移的发生率。结论：GCXXD通过阻断TGF-beta1/SMAD通路抑制EMT，从而抑制胃癌细胞生长和肝转移。本研究为中药治疗胃癌肝转移提供了数据支持，并对新型抗癌药物的研发具有重要意义。
